messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGED: ded-pool aurora-pool node gpu-07 reporting sustained ECC errors and PCIe AER resets. Potential tenant impact detected (enterprise VPC: AxiomHealth). Severity: P1. @alex oncall - please ack and triage.

alex: acked. I'm on it. pulling diagnostics now — linking metrics: https://metrics.redwood/aurora-pool/gpu-07 and logs: https://logs.redwood/aurora/gpu-07

derek: I can help with drain/tenant isolation if needed. ping me when you want me to run commands.

maria: @customer-success heads up: AxiomHealth is in the VPC reserved for them, high priority. Please prepare a customer comms draft once we have impact summary.

alex: quick findings — nvlink counters and ECC spikes on GPU0, kernel shows `AER: Uncorrected error` intermittently. Not a hard crash yet but unstable. Policy: start safe-drain and isolate affected tenant to reduce risk of session corruption.

alex: trying cordon + drain:```bash
redwoodctl node cordon aurora-pool/gpu-07
redwoodctl node drain aurora-pool/gpu-07 --grace 60s
```

jen: noticed `drain` is hanging on one vGPU workload belonging to tenant axiomhealth-prod-3 — it's a pinned session (long-run). There's a `PERSISTENT_GPU` annotation.

alex: that explains it. drain stuck because the session refused to migrate. We need to isolate the tenant rather than waiting. Derek, can you run the tenant isolation now?

derek: running:```bash
# isolate tenant traffic to fallback pool and mark sessions for graceful disconnect
redwoodctl tenant isolate --tenant axiomhealth --pool aurora-pool --reason "node ECC errors" --force
```

oncall-bot: command accepted, isolation job queued (job id: iso-20260315-87).

jen: isolation job status: `in_progress` — migrating routing rules -> sending new requests to ded-fallback-02. pinned sessions remain on gpu-07 until forced disconnect.

alex: forcing disconnect for the pinned session (last resort) — will coordinate with CS to warn customer.```bash
redwoodctl session terminate --session axiomhealth-prod-3 --force --note "evacuate pinned vGPU due to potential hardware error"
```

customer-success: sending immediate notice to AxiomHealth account team: "We are isolating your VPC and failing new traffic to a fallback pool due to an unstable GPU node. There may be brief session disruption for long-running pinned workloads; our team will continue to monitor and follow up." Will post in their private channel and escalate to their on-call.

maria: good. please include ETA for mitigation and whether there's any data loss risk. Alex, do we know risk profile?

alex: low likelihood of data loss for stateless requests. For pinned vGPU sessions there may be in-memory state lost — told CS to highlight that. Current observed customer error rate: 3.4% 5m spike, now trending to 0.8% after routing change.

lia: routing override completed: all new requests for axiomhealth-prod now go to ded-fallback-02 (confirmed via /route-debug). Old sessions: 1 pinned session terminated per command; session termination returned exit code 0.

oncall-bot: isolation job iso-20260315-87 completed successfully. Node cordon/drain continuing.

alex: re-run drain now that tenant pinned session has been cleared:```bash
redwoodctl node drain aurora-pool/gpu-07 --grace 30s --force-if-needed
```

jen: drain completed. Node moved to `drained` state. No other tenants impacted. Verified that axiomhealth traffic has zero 5xx in last 30s on fallback. :white_check_mark:

derek: marking node for hardware remediation and removing from rotation permanently until RMA:```bash
inventory mark-repair aurora-pool/gpu-07 --reason "ECC/PCIe AER" --ticket HW-7219
redwoodctl node set-state aurora-pool/gpu-07 repair
```

alex: created hardware ticket HW-7219 and pinged hw-ops. ETA for replacement board: 6-8 hours, vendor acceptance pending. Scheduling RMA now.

maria: customer update sent: short summary, steps we took, their sessions impacted (1 pinned session terminated), current status (traffic routed to fallback with <1% errors), next steps (hardware RMA, follow-up postmortem). AxiomHealth acknowledged and asked for a timeline and whether persistent storage was affected — confirmed not affected.

jen: monitoring note — enabling extra telemetry for the pool and setting alert threshold lower for the next 24h. Also created a temporary routing policy to keep AxiomHealth pinned away from aurora-pool until RMA complete.

lia: verifying overall cluster health: aurora-pool capacity reduced by 1 GPU node, autoscaler will pick up if load increases. No immediate capacity breach.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT STATUS UPDATE: mitigated -> tenant isolated, node drained and removed from rotation, customer traffic failed over to ded-fallback-02. Severity downgraded to P2 for tracking. Incident owner: derek. Postmortem assignee: alex.

derek: actions captured: 1) write postmortem with timeline and RCA 2) follow up with hw-ops on RMA completion 3) confirm routing policy removal after replacement 4) add a runbook step for pinned vGPU eviction workflows. Assigning due date: 2026-03-18.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll coordinate the customer follow-ups and loop in the account team. Any outstanding asks?

alex: nothing else from infra side. recommend a brief retrospective with CS + hw-ops tomorrow.

oncall-bot: Incident thread closed for active paging. Will re-open if new alerts surface. :eyes:
